name: K Raheja Artesia
address: Pandurang Budhkar Marg / Hind Cycle Marg, Hanuman Nagar, near Doordarshan Centre, Worli, Mumbai 400030
amenities: 23,000 sq ft drop-off lobby, 8.5 m high, designed by Martin Kemp Design
description: A single ultra-luxury residential tower on a roughly 5-acre plot near the Worli sea face, built by K. Raheja Private Limited (a K Raheja Corp group company). It has limited-edition 4 BHK residences, three to a floor, with views of the Arabian Sea and the Bandra-Worli Sea Link, and Art Deco-inspired interiors by London's Martin Kemp Design. Mint described it in 2018 as an upcoming 45-storey tower selling 3,000 sq ft homes by invitation at around Rs 30 crore. Since 2021, Raheja family members have bought and then resold several top-floor apartments, which set Worli records of Rs 1.55 to 1.82 lakh/sq ft of carpet in 2025-26.
notes: Status: Square Yards lists it ready to move since Jun 2019, and Wikipedia's list of tallest Mumbai buildings gives completion in 2019. MahaRERA (P51900000841, registered 23 Jul 2017) still showed it as ongoing with a proposed completion of 30 Dec 2023 (GeoSquare, verified Sep 2026). No OC date was found, so oc_received is left out. Floors conflict between sources: 45 storeys (Mint 2018 / Construction World 2021, which matches duplexes on floors 44-45), 49 (MGS Architecture), 54 (a RERA listing) and 58 floors / 210 m (Wikipedia list). Land: 4.97 acres per the developer; 5.2 acres per MGS; MahaRERA plot area 19,640.99 sq m. Units: 133 per MahaRERA / Zapkey, with 130 booked as of Nov 2025 (Square Yards); the 129 elsewhere on Square Yards conflicts. Mortgaged to HDFC Ltd (developer site). Design team: RSP (India) design consultants, Sterling Engineering (structure concept), Burega Farnell (landscape), BES (facade), AECOM (MEP), Martin Kemp Design and JPA Design (show apartments). Floor height is 3.9 m floor-to-floor (the developer page also captions it as floor-to-ceiling). Related-party deals: in Dec 2020 Neel, Chandru and Ravi Raheja and their wives bought three duplexes (18 flats, 42 car parks) for Rs 427.81 crore at the 2% Covid-era stamp duty, and from 2025 they resold some of these units. The two Feb 2026 sales (Rs 123.51 crore to Radha Tanti and Rs 121 crore to Shree Dhootapapeshwar) are both 44th-floor, 6,772 sq ft carpet units sold by Ravi and Sumati Raheja. Reported stamp duties differ (Rs 6.18 crore vs Rs 7.28 crore), and Square Yards lists the 26 Feb 2026 sale as unit 4402, so they are treated as two separate flats. This is not confirmed. Earlier buyers include Smita Parekh (Rs 50 crore), Keki Mistry (Rs 41.23 crore) and the Relli family (Rs 30.31 crore), all reported around 2021 with no area or date. Rent: Square Yards gave Rs 5-6 lakh/month for a 4 BHK in Sep 2025, but Nov 2026 listings ask Rs 16-17 lakh for 3,064 sq ft. These figures conflict. Computed gross yield: Rs 16 lakh x 12 / (3,064 sq ft x Rs 1,49,200 Square Yards asking) = about 4.2%; at registered rates of Rs 1.55-1.82 lakh it is about 3.4-4.0%. Both use asking rents.
architect: RSP (India) (design consultants); Martin Kemp Design (lobby, show apartment and common areas)

Registered deals from 2025-26: 5,342 and 6,772 sq ft carpet on the 43rd floor, 6,772 sq ft on the 44th, and a 7,747 sq ft resale unit (area basis not stated). These come with five or six car parks each.
Three duplexes on floors 41-45 of 1,989.71 to 2,138.25 sq m each (registered area, basis not stated), bought by Raheja family members in Dec 2020 for Rs 137.78 to 146.40 crore each.

news.title: New in luxury apartments: Designer lobby, in-house spa
news.summary: It describes Artesia as an upcoming 45-storey Worli tower of about 3,000 sq ft 4 BHK homes at around Rs 30 crore, sold by invitation only. Martin Kemp Design did the lobby and show apartment, and the tower has an in-house spa.

news.title: Raheja's purchase three duplexes at Rs 427 cr from own project in Worli
news.summary: Raheja family members bought three duplexes on floors 41-45 (66,811 sq ft) for Rs 427 crore on 31 Dec 2020, paying 2% stamp duty. Other buyers named are Smita Parekh (Rs 50 crore) and Keki Mistry (Rs 41.23 crore).

news.title: Mumbai Real Estate News: Blue Jet Healthcare Promoters Acquire 3 Luxury Worli Properties Worth Over ₹202 Crore
news.summary: On 28 Jul 2025 Blue Jet MD Shiven Arora bought a 7,747 sq ft Raheja Artesia resale apartment from Tanya Tayal for Rs 88.03 crore, with six car parks.

news.title: Ideal Cures Pharma Promoters Invest Rs 190.1 Crore in Mumbai's Luxury Real Estate
news.summary: On 24 Dec 2025 Suresh and Veena Pareek bought units 4302 and 4303 on the 43rd floor (12,114 sq ft carpet) from Chandru and Jyoti Raheja for a combined Rs 190.1 crore.

news.title: Suzlon Vice Chairman Girish Tanti's Wife Buys Rs 123.5 Crore Luxury Home in Worli
news.summary: Radha Tanti bought a 6,772 sq ft carpet, 44th-floor Artesia apartment from Ravi and Sumati Raheja for Rs 123.5 crore (about Rs 1.82 lakh/sq ft of carpet).

news.title: Mumbai-Based Ayurvedic Firm Shree Dhootapapeshwar Buys ₹121 Crore Luxury Apartment In Worli's Raheja Artesia
news.summary: Registered on 26 Feb 2026: a 6,772 sq ft carpet, 44th-floor apartment sold by Ravi and Sumati Raheja for Rs 121 crore, with Rs 7.28 crore stamp duty and six car parks.
